# Privacy Policy — Nextcloud Calendar Mobile

**Last updated: May 12, 2026**

---

## 1. Overview

Nextcloud Calendar Mobile is an unofficial Nextcloud client for iOS and Android. It connects to your Nextcloud instance via the CalDAV protocol to provide native calendar access.

---

## 2. Data Collected

The application **collects no personal data** and operates no servers of its own.

All data is processed **exclusively on your device and your Nextcloud instance**:

| Data | Handling |
|------|---------|
| Your Nextcloud instance URL | Stored locally on device |
| Login credentials (username / password) | Stored locally in the device's secure keystore |
| Calendar and event data | Fetched from your Nextcloud server via CalDAV — never sent to any third party |
| Nextcloud Talk rooms (if used) | Fetched from your Nextcloud server only |

---

## 3. Data Not Collected

The application does **not** collect, transmit, or store any of the following:

- Analytics or telemetry data
- Location data
- Advertising identifiers
- Contact information
- Browsing or behavioral data

---

## 4. Data Transmission

Data flows **only** between your device and your own Nextcloud instance. Nothing is sent to the app developers or any third-party service.

Connection security depends on your Nextcloud instance configuration (HTTPS strongly recommended).

---

## 5. Local Storage

Credentials are stored in the device's native secure storage (Keychain on iOS, Keystore on Android). Calendar data is cached locally to support offline access.

---

## 6. Required Permissions

The application may request the following permissions depending on the features used:

| Permission | Reason |
|------------|--------|
| Network access | Connect to your Nextcloud instance |
| Secure storage | Encrypted storage of credentials |

---

## 7. Third-Party Services

The application includes no third-party advertising, analytics, or tracking SDKs.

---

## 8. Children

The application is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect data from them.

---

## 9. Changes to This Policy

Any changes will be published in this file with an updated date. Continued use of the application after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

---

## 10. Contact

For any privacy-related questions, open an issue on the project's GitHub repository.
